name: stackbar
title: Stacked bar plot
about: Shows what the selected clusters are made of: one bar per cluster, split by level 2.

shows.segment length: number of features with that value

reads.level1: counts only the passing features (when the scope is filtered); level-1 values are not drawn
reads.level2: counts only the passing features (when the scope is filtered), so only the ticked segments remain
reads.scope: filtered features, or every feature of the selected clusters

features.name: level2_composition
features.how: number of features per level-2 value in the cluster, as the bar shows them

target.example: two or more <<L2>> values compared without naming clusters

descriptor.level2: "which <<L2>> values make up", "split", "fraction", "<<L2>> composition", level-2 counts per cluster.
